from pathlib import Path

repo = Path("/Users/steventran/jobpipe")

module = repo / "jobpipe_resolve.py"
module.write_text(
'''from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

from utils.tracker import get_all_jobs, update_apply_url
from utils.url_resolver import is_ats_url, resolve_and_update_url


async def resolve_matched(limit: int = 0) -> dict[str, Any]:
    jobs, _ = get_all_jobs(
        status="matched",
        sort_by="match_score",
        sort_order="desc",
        limit=limit or 10000,
    )
    results = []
    updated = direct = unresolved = failed = 0

    async with async_playwright() as playwright:
        browser = await playwright.chromium.launch(headless=True)
        context = await browser.new_context()
        page = await context.new_page()
        try:
            for job in jobs:
                original = str(job.get("apply_url") or job.get("url") or "").strip()
                if not original:
                    failed += 1
                    results.append({
                        "id": job.get("id"),
                        "company": job.get("company"),
                        "title": job.get("title"),
                        "resolution": "missing_url",
                    })
                    continue
                if is_ats_url(original):
                    direct += 1
                    results.append({
                        "id": job.get("id"),
                        "company": job.get("company"),
                        "title": job.get("title"),
                        "resolution": "ats_direct",
                        "url": original,
                    })
                    continue
                try:
                    result = await resolve_and_update_url(page, job)
                except Exception as exc:
                    failed += 1
                    results.append({
                        "id": job.get("id"),
                        "company": job.get("company"),
                        "title": job.get("title"),
                        "resolution": "error",
                        "error": type(exc).__name__,
                    })
                    continue
                resolved = str(result.get("resolved_url") or original).strip()
                resolution = str(result.get("resolution") or "unresolved")
                if resolved and resolved != original:
                    update_apply_url(job["id"], resolved)
                    updated += 1
                elif resolution == "unresolved":
                    unresolved += 1
                results.append({
                    "id": job.get("id"),
                    "company": job.get("company"),
                    "title": job.get("title"),
                    "resolution": resolution,
                    "url": resolved,
                })
        finally:
            await context.close()
            await browser.close()

    return {
        "considered": len(jobs),
        "ats_direct": direct,
        "updated": updated,
        "unresolved": unresolved,
        "failed": failed,
        "results": results,
    }
''',
encoding="utf-8"
)

jobctl = repo / "jobctl.py"
text = jobctl.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
anchor = "from jobpipe_queue import enqueue_matched as jobpipe_enqueue_matched\n"
import_line = "from jobpipe_resolve import resolve_matched as jobpipe_resolve_matched\n"
if import_line not in text:
    text = text.replace(anchor, anchor + import_line, 1)

marker = '    enqueue_parser = subparsers.add_parser("enqueue", help="Export matched jobs into the application queue")\n'
if 'subparsers.add_parser("resolve"' not in text:
    block = '''    resolve_parser = subparsers.add_parser("resolve", help="Resolve matched jobs to canonical application URLs")
    resolve_parser.add_argument("--limit", type=int, default=0)

'''
    text = text.replace(marker, block + marker, 1)

main_marker = '        if args.command == "enqueue":\n            jobpipe_print_json(jobpipe_enqueue_matched(args.csv, args.limit))\n            return 0\n'
if 'if args.command == "resolve":' not in text:
    text = text.replace(main_marker, '''        if args.command == "resolve":
            jobpipe_print_json(asyncio.run(jobpipe_resolve_matched(args.limit)))
            return 0
''' + main_marker, 1)

jobctl.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")

print("added jobpipe resolve command")
